evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: None present. Rep jumps straight into probing: 'Do you have just any top of mind, questions, concerns that I can kind of kick us off with?'
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked, but only after probing has already started. Customer raised date availability concern first, rep responded, then rep asked 'And then what other questions.' This is asked mid-probing, not upfront.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised concern about date availability ('the tenth achievable, I guess'). Rep confirmed it's available but did not ask follow-up questions to understand why the date mattered or what the underlying urgency was. No 'tell me more about that' follow-up. Shallow acknowledgment only.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No reflection. Rep acknowledged concerns but never summarized what was heard back to the customer ('So what I'm hearing is...'). Rep simply confirmed facts and moved on.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Extensive detail gathering: property type (apartment with 3 bedrooms, moving to 2-story house), floor/stories (second floor with stairs), rooms covered (master, living room, office/second bedroom, third bedroom, bathroom, patio), walking distance (~100 feet), additional rooms (detached garage 100 yards away), special items (washer/dryer, modular shelves, TVs). All seven items covered thoroughly.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not offered. Rep discussed what customer was packing vs. what Einstein would move, but never asked 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?'
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Not asked. Rep did not ask about typical box count or overflow/special collections (china, books) that might exceed a standard count.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Partial. Rep gave a range ('I estimated about six to seven hours') and mentioned prior move history ('it took us about five and a half hours'), but did not personalize the estimate to this customer's specific concerns or preparation level. The estimate was anchored to time but not to the customer's individual move characteristics beyond factual details.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Partial. Rep mentioned '2.5 hour minimum' ('we have that minimum of two and a half hours') and 'pay for what you use' framing. Did not proactively disclose trip fee, overnight fee, or packing materials fees. Did not fully frame the 'not a guess' or '15-minute increments' commitment.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep did not ask 'Does that feel fair?' or similar confirmation followed by silence. Rep moved directly into availability: 'So yeah, did you want to go ahead and just book that.'
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: None. No mention of On-Time Guarantee, discount terms, or starting to discount if late.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: None. No mention of No Worries Damage Coverage, $2,000 coverage, no-deductible framing, or that it's built into the rate.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Rep did not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent. Rep did not explicitly close the Two Promises section.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep never asked 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or a genuine final concerns check. Call moved directly from estimate to booking.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Full. Rep asked plainly: 'So yeah, did you want to go ahead and just book that.' No softened out, direct ask for the business.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Not mentioned. No reference to rate-lock or reservation terms for price guarantee.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Rep confirmed: date (October 10th), time window (8:00-8:30 AM), truck availability mentioned. Missing: phone number confirmation, arrival window detail (8:00-8:30 mentioned but not confirmed as acceptable), crew size not confirmed, addresses not confirmed, notes about customer concerns (upcoming baby, wife's condition, potential garage items) not documented for the crew.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask_quote: 'So yeah, did you want to go ahead and just book that.'

top_strength: Rep gathered exhaustive logistics detail (all seven categories covered) and maintained detailed mental inventory throughout the call, demonstrating strong control of the information-gathering phase.
coaching_note: Rep skipped the entire Two Promises section and final concerns check — neither On-Time Guarantee nor No Worries Damage Coverage was delivered, and no genuine final concerns question was asked before closing, leaving $20 in value-add messaging unused and the customer without key assurances.
